content.short: Innovator Chain is a Substrate-based, energy-efficient blockchain with EVM compatibility.
content.description: Innovator Chain is an energy-efficient, layer-one blockchain built on Substrate technology that blends Substrate's adaptability with Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) compatibility. It brings together essential ecosystems for project owners, including exchanges, NFT marketplaces, and crypto shops, and provides a broad set of built-in products and services within its chain runtime to boost project utility and growth. This design supports diverse use cases and ecosystem integration.
